Although proposal debits and credits each total 99.95, it credits repairs only 99.90 and invents a 0.05 rounding-account effect; account-level reversal is not exact.
The journal reversal arithmetic is exact, but only invoice context exists. The required typed duplicate_confirmation for exactly the source pair is absent.

This deliberately nonobvious pair has matching purchase identity, date, amount, and duplicate confirmation, but a typed distinct_purchases record for the same pair makes reversal definitely unsafe under the documented contract. The conflicting evidence classification is synthetic and intentional.
Arithmetic and evidence pass in isolation, but the target appears in prior_reversals; another reversal would duplicate the correcting effect.
The reversal is mathematically exact and supported, but history_complete is false, so absence of an earlier reversal is indeterminate and accounting checks cannot pass.
The proposal is in-period but dated before both source postings, violating the temporal requirement even though arithmetic and evidence otherwise align.

trial_limitations: All entities, journals, evidence, and amounts are invented and contain no client data.
Expected outcomes are author predictions grounded in the published interface contract and journal arithmetic; the evaluator has not been run or imported.
Typed evidence is assumed supplied as stated and is not authenticated; free text is not interpreted.

Passing means checks passed within the evaluator's narrow supplied-data scope only. It does not establish accounting truth, authorize or perform posting, prove ledger effect, or constitute independent professional accounting assurance.
The trial does not test reviewer approval because every case sets require_review false.
M05 is explicitly a challenge case involving contradictory typed classifications; all other members stay within the narrow documented duplicate-reversal contract.
